verdict.rationale: Better Stack status pages let viewers subscribe to email updates (pitched for customers). Pages can be made private with password, SSO or IP protection, so internal stakeholders could plausibly follow incidents without joining the response channel. However, the evidence never confirms that subscriptions work on private, internal-only pages. It also never describes how incident updates are structured or authored. Missing for 10: explicit internal or stakeholder-subscriber workflow, documented subscriptions on private pages, structured update templates or stages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
